QuestInfo.name: Monitoring the Vibrations
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has something to ask of you.
QuestInfo.1: Monitor the flow of good vibes in Maple World by staying logged in for 30 minutes with Cassandra's Good Vibe Detector in your Inventory.
QuestInfo.2: I hope we can keep good vibes in the air of Maple World!
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP based on level per 1 Award Coin

0.0: Can you feel it? In the air? That's right...we're running low on good vibes in Maple World! Without good vibes, things will be...y'know...bad. We need to find out how low on good vibes we are, so can you help me?

yes.0: Groovy! Okay, take this Good Vibe Detector and stay logged in for 30 minutes. It will read the vibes in the air, and calculate how low on good vibes we are. Bring me the detector after 30 minutes, okay?

no.0: You're not gonna help? That's harsh, dude.

1.0: The detector's done? Okay, let's see how the good vibes are doing...

yes.0: I was afraid of this... Maple World is critically low on good vibes! I'll have to think of a way to fix this, but for now, have some EXP for helping me out. Come back later, and maybe we can do something to bring the good vibes back.

item.0: I don't think enough vibes have been detected, dude.
